frontPage.headline: 18th BRICS Summit Concludes in New Delhi with Adoption of New Delhi Declaration
frontPage.summary: The 18th BRICS Summit hosted in New Delhi concluded with the unanimous adoption of the New Delhi Declaration. Member nations focused on reforms in global governance, expanding trade settlements in local currencies, establishing independent trade insurance platforms, and avoiding the weaponisation of technology and critical minerals.
frontPage.whyItMatters: Demonstrates India's balancing role in global diplomacy, bridging Global South priorities with major global powers while advancing multilateral institutional reforms.

frontPage.headline: India Completes 2,843-km Dedicated Freight Corridor Network
frontPage.summary: With the commissioning of final operational stretches, India has fully completed its 2,843-km Dedicated Freight Corridor (DFC) network, spanning both the Eastern and Western DFCs. The milestone aims to drastically reduce freight transit times, boost railway freight share, and cut logistics costs in line with National Logistics Policy goals.
frontPage.whyItMatters: High-priority infrastructure topic under GS III, essential for analyzing supply chain efficiency, industrial corridors, and eco-friendly freight transport.

frontPage.headline: Protests Mount in Western Ghats over Centre's 7th Draft Notification on Ecologically Sensitive Areas
frontPage.summary: Local communities in the high-range districts of Kerala have renewed protests against the Union Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change's seventh draft notification declaring Ecologically Sensitive Areas (ESAs) in the Western Ghats. High-range residents cite concerns over restrictions on agriculture, construction, and livelihoods.
frontPage.whyItMatters: Connects directly to the Kasturirangan and Gadgil Committee reports on Western Ghats ecology versus developmental and community rights.

frontPage.headline: Union Home Minister Signals Uniform Civil Code Implementation Plan Across States
frontPage.topic: Directive Principles of State Policy & Constitutional Law
frontPage.summary: Union Home Minister Amit Shah announced plans to introduce Uniform Civil Code (UCC) legislation across 21 states prior to 2029. The initiative builds on Uttarakhand's legislative model to standardize personal laws governing marriage, divorce, inheritance, and adoption across religious communities.
frontPage.whyItMatters: Directly linked to Article 44 of the Directive Principles of State Policy, personal law reforms, gender equality, and federal legislative competence.

frontPage.headline: India and Vietnam to Accelerate Maritime Security Ties and Defence Technology Sharing
frontPage.summary: India and Vietnam agreed to deepen their strategic partnership by accelerating defence tech transfers, joint naval exercises, and maritime domain awareness across the Indo-Pacific region. The move underlines India's Act East Policy and focus on freedom of navigation in regional waters.
frontPage.whyItMatters: Key element of India's Act East strategy and maritime diplomacy in Southeast Asia.

gs2.headline: Bangladesh Expresses Intent to Reset Bilateral Relations with India via Direct Discussions
gs2.summary: Bangladesh's State Minister for Foreign Affairs emphasized the country's interest in moving toward a balanced, pragmatic bilateral relationship with India through direct engagements. The minister noted the need to move beyond historical friction to focus on trade, transit, and regional stability.
gs2.whyItMatters: Critical for understanding shifting political dynamics in South Asia and India's 'Neighborhood First' policy.

gs2.headline: Ministry of Home Affairs Consults Ladakh Stakeholders on UT Governance and Representative Structure
gs2.topic: Governance, UT Administration & Sixth Schedule Demands
gs2.summary: The Union Ministry of Home Affairs has submitted a questionnaire to Ladakh governance groups regarding proposed representative mechanisms, direct election mandates, and administrative safeguards for the Union Territory.
gs2.whyItMatters: Relates to Sixth Schedule demands, constitutional safeguards for indigenous tribal populations, and UT administrative structures.

gs3.headline: Pygmy Hog Population Shows Recovery Following Conservation and Captive Breeding Efforts
gs3.summary: Assam's conservation programs have reported a successful recovery of the Pygmy Hog (Porcula salvania), the world's smallest and rarest wild pig species. Once thought extinct, wild numbers have increased from just 6 individuals in 1996 to nearly 200 in monitored grasslands today following structured captive breeding and reintroduction.
gs3.whyItMatters: A prime example of species recovery programs in tall grassland ecosystems (such as Manas National Park) relevant for Prelims and Mains environment questions.

gs3.headline: India-France Space Enterprises Sign Strategic Industry Agreements
gs3.topic: Space Technology & International Bilateral Tech Cooperation
gs3.summary: Indian and French commercial space firms signed three key agreements to boost satellite component manufacturing, launch services cooperation, and joint earth observation data sharing, building on the strategic space partnership between ISRO and CNES.
gs3.whyItMatters: Highlights growing private sector involvement in India's space ecosystem following IN-SPACe reforms.

gs3.headline: RBI Issues Guidelines Restricting Account Freezing to Disputed Amounts in Cyber Fraud Investigations
gs3.summary: The Reserve Bank of India clarified regulatory norms directing commercial banks to freeze only the specific quantum of money tied to disputed or fraudulent transactions during cybercrime investigations, rather than blocking an account holder's entire bank balance.
gs3.whyItMatters: Protects consumer rights and financial stability while enhancing procedural clarity for law enforcement handling financial fraud.

gs3.headline: Indian Semiconductor Ecosystem Reaches $1.4 Billion in Private Investment
gs3.summary: Equity funding into India's semiconductor design, fabless startup, and assembly ecosystem has crossed $1.4 billion across 281 companies, with nearly half of the investments coming in recent years supported by the India Semiconductor Mission (ISM).
gs3.whyItMatters: Reflects progress under the Semiconductor Mission, essential for domestic manufacturing, supply chain resilience, and tech sovereignty.

prelimsRadar.fact: Dedicated Freight Corridor Corporation of India Limited (DFCCIL)
prelimsRadar.detail: A Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV) under the Ministry of Railways created to construct, maintain, and operate the Western and Eastern Dedicated Freight Corridors.

quiz.question:
With reference to the Pygmy Hog (Porcula salvania), consider the following statements:
1. It is the world's smallest wild pig species.
2. It is endemic to the tropical rainforests of the Western Ghats.
3. Reintroduction programs have successfully established populations in Manas National Park.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
quiz.explanation: Statement 1 is correct. Statement 2 is incorrect because the Pygmy Hog is endemic to sub-Himalayan alluvial grasslands (such as in Assam), not Western Ghats rainforests. Statement 3 is correct as reintroduction programs centered around Manas National Park.

quiz.question: The Tso Kar Wetland Complex, recently in news for glacial water stream channelization, is located in which State/UT?
quiz.explanation: Tso Kar is a high-altitude Ramsar site situated in the Changthang region of Ladakh.

quiz.question:
Consider the following operational corridors in Indian Railways:
1. Eastern Dedicated Freight Corridor (EDFC)
2. Western Dedicated Freight Corridor (WDFC)
Which of the following points serves as the junction linking both corridors?
quiz.explanation: The Eastern DFC (Ludhiana to Dankuni) and Western DFC (Jawaharlal Nehru Port to Dadri) meet at Dadri in Uttar Pradesh.

quiz.question: Under Article 44 of the Constitution of India, the State shall endeavor to secure for citizens a Uniform Civil Code throughout the territory of India. This provision is contained under:
quiz.explanation: Article 44 forms part of Part IV (Directive Principles of State Policy) of the Indian Constitution.

quiz.question: What is the primary objective of using environmental DNA (eDNA) sampling techniques in ecological studies?
options: To modify genetic sequences of endangered species
To detect presence of biological organisms from cellular shed in environmental media like water, air, or spider webs
To clone extinct fauna using preserved skeletal samples
To track satellite telemetry signals of wild herds
quiz.explanation: eDNA sampling isolates trace genetic material left behind by organisms in soil, water, air, or natural traps (like spider webs) to non-invasively identify biodiversity.

schemes.name: India Semiconductor Mission (ISM)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)
schemes.beneficiaries: Semiconductor design companies, fabrication plants, packaging units, and research institutions
schemes.objective: Build a vibrant, self-reliant semiconductor and display design and manufacturing ecosystem in India.
keyFeatures: Financial support up to 50% of project cost for setting up Semiconductor Fabs and Display Fabs.
Design Linked Incentive (DLI) scheme offering financial incentives and infrastructure support for domestic chip design.
schemes.funding: Rs 76,000 crore outlay under the National Semiconductor Policy
schemes.upscRelevance: Highly relevant for GS III (Indigenisation of Technology, Electronics Manufacturing, Supply Chain Resilience).

points: Operationalisation of 2,843 km Dedicated Freight Corridors (DFCs) increases average freight train speeds from ~25 km/h to over 60 km/h, reducing logistics costs towards the target of 8% of GDP.
DFCs decouple heavy freight traffic from passenger routes, increasing line capacity across trunk routes of Indian Railways.

The New Delhi Declaration at the 18th BRICS Summit highlights growing consensus among Global South nations for non-dollar trade settlement mechanisms and reformed quota shares in multilateral financial institutions like the IMF.

whatToRemember: Completion of India's 2,843-km Dedicated Freight Corridor network marks a milestone in logistics cost reduction.
The 18th BRICS Summit in New Delhi adopted the New Delhi Declaration, emphasizing local currency trade and global institution reforms.
Assam's captive breeding program revived the endangered Pygmy Hog from 6 in 1996 to nearly 200 today.
MHA has initiated structural queries on UT governance and representation for Ladakh.
RBI updated account freezing guidelines to restrict blocks only to disputed funds in cyber fraud cases.
